summary: Iteration 56 validated three surgical UX changes: simplified CheckInPage (name+email+phone+location), Role picker moved from CheckInPage to MyAccountPage, and simplified SignupForm (no username/password). All backend (6/6) and frontend (20/20) tests passed with 100% success.
critical_code_review_comments: MyAccountPage.jsx is >1500 lines; consider splitting into ProfileTab, TokensTab, TipTab, EarningsTab components for maintainability.

SignupForm.jsx still contains dead 'handleEmailSignup' logic (username/password validation) that is no longer reachable since authMode='signup' now uses handleQuickSignup. Safe to prune to reduce confusion.

CheckInPage uses `window.location.origin` directly for API calls instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works because backend is same origin, but inconsistent with rest of codebase — recommend using the api service module for the /api/checkin call too.
seed_data_creation: Created test profiles: dj_test_route@example.com (role=staff, staff_title=dj), and dynamic guest_new_<ts>@example.com, role_ui_<ts>@example.com, ss_<ts>@example.com per run.
test_credentials: N/A — new profiles are created per test run; admin creds not needed for these flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 56 verified: 1) /checkin and /login both render simplified CheckInPage (name/email/phone/location; role toggle & staff-position grid removed). 2) DJ auto-routing: check-in with an email whose profile has staff_title='dj' redirects to /dj. 3) New guest email creates profile via POST /api/user/profile and redirects to /social/<slug>. 4) Returning guest — form prefills name/email/phone from saved profile. 5) MyAccountPage: profile-role-section renders 6 role buttons (guest/dj/bartender/server/cook/manager); saving persists role & staff_title via PUT /api/user/profile/{id}. 6) End-to-end: setting role=dj in My Account then hitting /checkin routes user to /dj. 7) SignupForm simplified — only name/email/phone inputs, no username/password/confirm/showPassword; POST /api/user/profile creates account and sets localStorage.ff_user_profile_id.
rca of the issue: No issues found; all functionality works as specified.
